title: Manufacturing Classification (Construction-Related Establishment)
summary: Decision tree for whether a construction-related establishment (e.g. a cabinet shop) is classified as manufacturing and assessed by the Department of Revenue, based on cabinet-shop status, share of sales to contractors/wholesale, share of employment in installation, and manufacturing SIC code.
disclaimer: This figure provides general classification guidance. A thorough review of each establishment is still required.
router_description: Manufacturing classification. Decision tree for whether a construction-related establishment or cabinet shop is manufacturing, assessed by Department of Revenue, based on sales to contractors, employment in installation, and SIC code.
notes: Reference guidance from the Manufacturing Division SIC materials: sheet metal, concrete, and terrazzo products and similar construction materials are in the manufacturing division; woodworking in connection with construction, reconditioning/repair, or work performed to individual order is nonmanufacturing; wood kitchen cabinets and bathroom vanities for permanent installation are manufacturing, freestanding cabinets/vanities are Major Group 25, and custom cabinets built for individuals are Retail Trade Industry 5712.
